definitions: The grip of a tyre or wheel on a road or a rail.
The action of drawing or pulling a thing over a surface, especially a road or track.
The extent to which an idea, product, etc., gains popularity or acceptance.
A pulling force applied to a limb or other part of the body to maintain alignment or to relieve pressure.
examples: The car lost traction on the icy road.
The new policy is gaining traction among voters.
Skeletal traction was used to treat the fracture.
